description: Land Title Settlement Department - Koswatta, Katana D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511200
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains detailed declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including parcel numbers, ownership details, extents, encumbrances, and legal status. The content is focused entirely on land and property-related administrative matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements.
